schema.text: Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scooter, or why do you ride so rarely? (Select all that apply)
schema.help: We ask this to understand what limits the use of motorcycles and scooters for different people. Answering is optional, and you can also choose not to say.

options.text: I don't need to: other ways of getting around suit me better
I don't have a licence or a vehicle
It feels too dangerous in traffic
Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblestones, tram tracks)
My health, a disability or my age makes it difficult

en.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scooter, or why do you ride so rarely? (Select all that apply)
en.#We ask this to understand what limits t: We ask this to understand what limits the use of motorcycles and scooters for different people. Answering is optional, and you can also choose not to say.
en.#I don't have a licence or a vehicle: I don't have a licence or a vehicle
en.#It feels too dangerous in traffic: It feels too dangerous in traffic
en.#Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblesto: Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblestones, tram tracks)
en.#My health, a disability or my age makes: My health, a disability or my age makes it difficult
en.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: I don't need to: other ways of getting around suit me better

it.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: Perché non usi la moto o lo scooter, o perché li usi così poco? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Lo chiediamo per capire che cosa limita l'uso della moto e dello scooter per persone diverse. Rispondere è facoltativo e puoi anche scegliere di non dirlo.
it.#I don't have a licence or a vehicle: Non ho la patente o il mezzo
it.#It feels too dangerous in traffic: Mi sembra troppo pericoloso nel traffico
it.#Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblesto: Manto stradale in cattive condizioni (buche, sampietrini, binari del tram)
it.#My health, a disability or my age makes: La mia salute, una disabilità o l'età me lo rendono difficile
it.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Non mi serve: altri modi di spostarmi sono più adatti a me

fr.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: Pourquoi n'utilisez-vous pas de moto ou de scooter, ou pourquoi si rarement ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Nous posons cette question pour comprendre ce qui limite l'usage de la moto et du scooter selon les personnes. Répondre est facultatif, et vous pouvez aussi choisir de ne pas le dire.
fr.#I don't have a licence or a vehicle: Je n'ai pas le permis ou pas de véhicule
fr.#It feels too dangerous in traffic: Cela me semble trop dangereux dans la circulation
fr.#Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblesto: Le mauvais état de la chaussée (nids-de-poule, pavés, rails de tramway)
fr.#Heat or bad weather: La chaleur ou le mauvais temps
fr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Ma santé, un handicap ou mon âge rendent cela difficile
fr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Je n'en ai pas besoin : d'autres moyens de déplacement me conviennent mieux

de.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: Warum fahren Sie nicht oder so selten Motorrad oder Motorroller? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Wir fragen dies, um zu verstehen, was die Nutzung von Motorrad und Roller für verschiedene Menschen einschränkt. Die Antwort ist freiwillig, und Sie können auch angeben, dass Sie es lieber nicht sagen möchten.
de.#I don't have a licence or a vehicle: Ich habe keinen Führerschein oder kein Fahrzeug
de.#It feels too dangerous in traffic: Es erscheint mir im Verkehr zu gefährlich
de.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Meine Gesundheit, eine Behinderung oder mein Alter machen es mir schwer
de.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Ich brauche es nicht: Andere Fortbewegungsarten passen besser zu mir

tr.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: Motosiklet veya scooter neden kullanmıyorsunuz ya da neden bu kadar az kullanıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Bunu, farklı kişiler için motosiklet ve scooter kullanımını neyin sınırladığını anlamak için soruyoruz. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır; belirtmemeyi de seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblesto: Kötü yol yüzeyleri (çukurlar, parke taşları, tramvay rayları)
tr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Sağlığım, bir engelim veya yaşım bunu zorlaştırıyor
tr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Gerek duymuyorum: başka ulaşım yolları bana daha uygun

fa.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: چرا از موتورسیکلت یا اسکوتر موتوری استفاده نمی‌کنید یا چرا این‌قدر کم استفاده می‌کنید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#We ask this to understand what limits t: این را می‌پرسیم تا بفهمیم چه چیزی استفاده از موتورسیکلت و اسکوتر را برای افراد مختلف محدود می‌کند. پاسخ دادن اختیاری است و می‌توانید ترجیح دهید آن را نگویید.
fa.#It feels too dangerous in traffic: در ترافیک به نظرم خیلی خطرناک است
fa.#Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblesto: سطح نامناسب جاده (چاله، سنگ‌فرش، ریل تراموا)
fa.#My health, a disability or my age makes: وضعیت سلامتی، معلولیت یا سنم این کار را دشوار می‌کند
fa.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: نیازی ندارم: روش‌های دیگر جابه‌جایی برایم مناسب‌ترند

hu.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: Miért nem motorozik vagy robogózik, vagy miért csak ilyen ritkán? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Azért kérdezzük, hogy megértsük, mi korlátozza a motor és a robogó használatát a különböző emberek számára. A válaszadás nem kötelező, és azt is választhatja, hogy nem kívánja megadni.
hu.#Heat or bad weather: A hőség vagy a rossz idő
hu.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Az egészségi állapotom, egy fogyatékosság vagy a korom megnehezíti
hu.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Nincs rá szükségem: más közlekedési módok jobban megfelelnek nekem

ar.#Why don't you ride a motorcycle or scoo: لماذا لا تقود الدراجة النارية أو السكوتر، أو لماذا تقودها نادرًا؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#We ask this to understand what limits t: نسأل عن ذلك لنفهم ما الذي يحدّ من استخدام الدراجة النارية والسكوتر لدى أشخاص مختلفين. الإجابة اختيارية، ويمكنك أيضًا اختيار عدم الإفصاح.
ar.#It feels too dangerous in traffic: يبدو لي خطيرًا جدًا وسط حركة المرور
ar.#Poor road surfaces (potholes, cobblesto: سوء حالة سطح الطريق (الحفر، الحجارة المرصوفة، سكك الترام)
ar.#My health, a disability or my age makes: صحتي أو إعاقة أو عمري يجعل ذلك صعبًا
ar.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: لا أحتاج إلى ذلك: وسائل تنقّل أخرى تناسبني أكثر
